title: Add RAG UX component kit and embeddable 'playlet' samples
author: Jordan Lee
description: Introduce a lightweight RAG UX component kit ("playlets") and a set of embeddable example apps to help product and docs teams prototype retrieval-augmented components quickly. Motivation: teams building product-facing RAG experiences repeatedly reimplement the same micro-UI patterns (progressive streaming, partial response placeholders, tool-call to external connectors, provenance footers). This PR adds: 1) a small React/TS component library of three composable widgets (QueryBox, ResultStream, ToolCallPane) that are framework-agnostic and styled with CSS vars; 2) Storybook with interactive knobs and live index toggles; 3) serverless adapter examples (Vercel + Cloud Run) that wire an example vector index and the Redwood public hosted API for quick smoke demos; 4) a minimal Python adapter example for teams that want a fast back-end shim; 5) docs and a short authoring guide focused on telemetry hooks and UX accessibility considerations. Checklist: - [x] component library + storybook - [x] serverless adapters and README - [x] structured output example + TypeScript types - [x] authoring guide and telemetry hook examples - [x] CI storybook build smoke tests - [x] lightweight demo dataset and index script How to try locally: follow examples/rag-playlets/README.md to start Storybook and the local dev server; the serverless adapters include a single command deploy script for Vercel. Links: Linear: ENG-7642; Demo page (staged): https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/playlets (temporary). Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the runtime integration shallow (uses Redwood hosted API by default) so product teams can iterate without provisioning Dedicated or Private instances. For customers who need private connectivity, serverless adapter README includes guidance to swap to a VPC Connector or to the private control plane.
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial scaffold of playlet library and storybook (src/components, storybook config, basic CSS vars); add serverless adapters (examples/vercel-adapter, examples/cloudrun-adapter) and a small Python shim; docs and telemetry authoring guide; follow-up commit fixes Storybook accessibility warnings and adds CI smoke test script.

release_notes: Add RAG 'playlets' component kit and embeddable sample apps for rapid prototyping. Includes React/TS components, Storybook, serverless adapters (Vercel/Cloud Run), a Python shim, and telemetry authoring guidance.
notes_for_releasers: This is a docs/examples addition. No API or runtime changes. Recommend announcing in the developer newsletter and adding a short entry in the docs site frontpage under "Quickstarts & Examples". The staged demo URL will be retired after 30 days; customers should follow serverless adapter readmes to deploy their own demos.
local_testing_instructions: 1) cd examples/rag-playlets && npm install && npm run storybook 2) Open Storybook at http://localhost:6006 to interact with playlets 3) Start local dev server: cd examples/rag-playlets && npm run dev 4) To try serverless adapter locally, set REDWOOD_API_KEY and run the vercel adapter locally with 'npm run dev' in examples/vercel-adapter, or run the Cloud Run adapter with the included Dockerfile and sample corpus. 5) Run 'ci/run-storybook-smoke.sh' to replicate CI smoke test.
notes: Kept runtime coupling minimal so teams can iterate; next planned follow-up: add a 'pinned index' example for Dedicated customers and an examples matrix for offline indexing flows.
